ja: 会いたかったぞ・・・・　ガンダム！―
『機動戦士ガンダム００』より、グラハム・エーカーが搭乗するグラハム専用ユニオンフラッグカスタムⅡ(GNフラッグ)が満を持してHGでプラモデル化。疑似太陽炉と接続可能なビームサーベルと各所に設定した可動部により、再現度の高いポージングが可能。ゴーグルは展開状態への変形も可能。
●　グラハム専用ユニオンフラッグカスタムⅡ(GNフラッグ)ついにプラモデル化　・頭部ゴーグル部分は開閉が可能。　・リード線が付属しており疑似太陽炉とビームサーベルを接続可能。
●　疑似太陽炉の背中から左肩への移動を再現！　・疑似太陽炉は左右に可動　・ビームサーベル使用時の疑似太陽炉の背中から左肩への移動を再現可能
●　広い可動範囲を実現！　　肩部のパーツを引き出すことで可動範囲が拡大。　　また、胴体や脚部の広い可動範囲により、再現性の高いポージングができるプラモデルを実現。　・肩を引き出すことで可動範囲が拡大。　・深い前屈が可能。　・脚部は広く可動し自在なポージングが可能。
●　手首の可動により、突きのポージングが可能！　　手首がパーツが可動し自然な形でGNビームサーベルを突き刺すポージングが可能に。
●　各種武装が付属　　プラズマソード用の青のエフェクトパーツも収録　　前腕部にプラズマソードを格納可能　　リニアライフルも収録
付属武装 ：　GNビームサーベル/プラズマソード/リニアライフル

en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam 00", Graham's Union Flag Custom II (GN Flag), piloted by Graham Aker, has finally been made into an HG plastic model. Highly reproducible posing is possible with the beam saber that can be connected to the pseudo solar furnace and the movable parts set in various places. The goggles can also be transformed into an expanded state.

● Graham's exclusive Union Flag Custom II (GN Flag) has finally been made into a plastic model. - The head goggle part can be opened and closed. - A lead wire is included to connect the pseudo solar furnace and beam saber.

● Reproduce the movement of the pseudo solar furnace from the back to the left shoulder! - The pseudo solar furnace can be moved left and right. - It is possible to reproduce the movement of the pseudo solar furnace from the back to the left shoulder when using the beam saber.

● Realizes a wide range of motion! The range of motion is expanded by pulling out the shoulder parts. In addition, the wide range of motion of the torso and legs allows for a plastic model that allows for highly reproducible poses. - Expands the range of motion by pulling out the shoulders. - Deep forward bends are possible. -The legs are widely movable and can be posed in any way you like.
● The wrists can be moved to create thrust poses! The wrist parts are movable, allowing for a natural pose of stabbing the GN beam saber.
● Various weapons are included. Blue effect parts for the plasma sword are also included. Plasma sword can be stored in the forearm. Linear rifle is also included.
Attached weapons: GN beam saber/plasma sword/linear rifle
1/144 Scale Assembly type plastic model Target age: 8 years old No adhesive is used for the above product materials: PS, PVC, and Assembly.
